name: pod-watcher-periodic-resync
description: PodWatcher periodic force-relist (WARREN_K8S_POD_WATCHER_RESYNC_MS, default 5 min) is warren's backstop against a silently-stalled watch or a missed DELETED event. Without it, a phantom cache entry masks K8sProvider.status() (which reads the cache first) and the watchdog terminal-reconcile net, so a run row wedges 'running' until an operator forces a second cancel — that's the warren-4f2b incident. Combined with the 2-min watchdog reconcile grace + 30s tick, a deleted pod's run reaches burrow_run_lost within ~8 min worst case.

name: synthesized-terminal-envelope
description: warren-9a4a: the in-pod agent entrypoint synthesizes a terminal agent_end envelope when the agent exits without one (isTerminalEnvelope tracks parsed events via src/core/event-envelope.ts extractAgentEventEnvelope; emitSynthesizedTerminalEnvelope emits post-exit with stopReason error on non-zero exit). Reap terminalizes ONLY on result|agent_end on the state_change/system carrier, so any new in-pod kill path must leave a terminal envelope behind or the run hangs in running.
